summary: Phase B stack-upgrade (sprint 2026-W36) after a GREEN Phase A baseline (v1.0.0, 100/100). Java 21->25 LTS, Spring Boot 3.5.14->3.5.16, latest-stable pins, pruned #25 CVE overrides, and a GATED Spring Boot 4 breaking-change scan. Every issue edits pom.xml, so the plan is a mostly-SEQUENTIAL verify-gated ladder (parallel workers would merge-conflict on pom.xml); each issue is its own feature branch -> PR -> green `./mvnw verify` + CI -> merge to dev. Spring Boot 4 adoption is deferred to an explicit HITL go/no-go.

waves.label: Wave 1 — Upgrade foundation (Spring Boot 3.5.16, then Java 25 LTS)
waves.blurb: #70 SB 3.5.16 first (JDK-25-capable BOM), then #71 Java 25 LTS + Lombok/Mockito/compiler/jib enablers. Everything downstream is verified on the final Java 25 runtime.

waves.label: Wave 2 — Pinned-dependency bumps
waves.blurb: #72 postgres 42.7.13, #73 jjwt 0.13.0 (auth-critical), #74 housekeeping (springdoc 2.9.0, bucket4j, caffeine, jib, mvnw 3.9.16). Sequential — all edit pom.xml. Depends on Wave 1.

waves.label: Wave 3 — Prune #25 CVE overrides vs SB 3.5.16 BOM
waves.blurb: #75 re-evaluate jackson/netty(4.1.x)/tomcat(10.1.x)/postgres overrides against the new BOM; drop redundant, keep CVE-necessary, stay Trivy-clean. Runs after the pin bumps.

waves.label: Wave 4 — Spring Boot 4 scan (GATED, HITL go/no-go)
waves.blurb: #76 breaking-change scan + go/no-go report only. No SB4 merge without Diangelo's explicit approval via the bridge.
